test_title: PYST 49: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 21 Feb, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose ‘No error’.

Neither of the teachers is participating on this event.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the second part of the given sentence, the preposition 'on' is incorrect.
 
• In the given sentence, the correct preposition should be 'in' instead of 'on'.
 
• Therefore, the correct preposition should be 'in' to indicate participation in an event.

Hence, the correct statement is '***Neither of the teachers is participating in this event__*__.'__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• The preposition **'in'** is used when referring to participation or involvement in an event or activity.
 
• Example: ***She is taking part in__ the competition*.**
